one_line: Rashtrakuta emperor whose northern campaign shaped the prestige politics of the Tripartite Struggle around Kanauj.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a disciplined warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, thick arched brows, a neatly trimmed short moustache, calm but piercing dark eyes; default expression is composed and regal with a hint of steely focus
appearance.hair: black hair worn to the nape of the neck, smoothed back and gathered into a low knot secured with a narrow gold band; a modest, era-appropriate Deccani-style gold coronet with a central oval ruby sits on the forehead, not overly tall
appearance.costume: knee-length deep indigo silk angarkha-style tunic with side-tie opening, fitted sleeves to the wrist and a subtle woven geometric border in muted gold; over it, a sleeveless fitted quilted cotton coat in warm maroon with simple stitching, worn like light armor; lower body in off-white cotton dhoti wrapped in the Deccan style, pleated in front and reaching the ankles, bordered with a thin dark green stripe; a broad, soft leather belt dyed dark brown with a simple gold buckle sits at the natural waist; over his left shoulder and across the torso he wears a saffron-yellow silk uttariya (shawl) with a narrow red border, draped neatly and never slipping; on his feet, brown leather strapped sandals with simple metal studs; jewellery is dignified and restrained—medium-width gold kadas (bracelets) on both wrists, a single gold armlet with a lotus motif on the right upper arm, small round gold stud earrings, and a plain gold ring on his right hand; no fantasy plate armor, only quilted cloth and leather reinforcing a practical royal-warrior outfit suitable for c. 800 CE Deccan and northern campaigning
appearance.signature: a straight, slightly broad-bladed steel sword with a simple Deccan hilt and a small disc pommel, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with gold fittings and worn at his left hip, which he often rests his right hand upon in a composed, commanding pose

ref_desc: Govinda III is a medium-brown, early-30s Deccan king with an oval face, short moustache, black hair in a low knot under a simple gold coronet, wearing a deep indigo tunic, maroon quilted vest, off-white dhoti, saffron shawl, gold ornaments, and a plain-hilted steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Govinda III Rashtrakuta as a dignified early-30s South Indian emperor: medium-brown complexion, oval face, strong jaw, straight nose, thick brows, calm but piercing dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed short moustache. His black hair is smoothed back into a low knot at the nape of his neck, secured with a narrow gold band, and he wears a modest Deccan-style gold coronet with a central oval ruby on his forehead. Dress him in a knee-length deep indigo silk angarkha-style tunic with fitted long sleeves and a subtle woven gold geometric border, over which is a sleeveless fitted warm maroon quilted cotton coat that looks like light armor. His lower body is wrapped in an off-white cotton dhoti in Deccan style, pleated in front, ankle-length, with a thin dark green border. A broad dark brown leather belt with a simple gold buckle sits at his waist, and a saffron-yellow silk uttariya (shawl) with a narrow red border is draped from his left shoulder across his torso, hanging neatly. Put brown leather strapped sandals on his feet. Add restrained gold jewellery: medium-width gold bracelets on both wrists, one lotus-motif gold armlet on the right upper arm, small round gold stud earrings, and a plain gold ring on his right hand. At his left hip, show his signature straight steel sword with a slightly broad blade and simple Deccan hilt, in a dark brown leather scabbard with gold fittings, his right hand lightly resting on the hilt in a composed, commanding stance. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, warm maroon, saffron yellow, off-white, and gold, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show hair, coronet, costume details, and sword placement.
